messages:
Riley: Weekend dilemma — Community Garden Spring Fair Saturday morning (plants, little band, pie contest) or indie cinema double feature Saturday night (two arthouse films + discussion)? Which vibes? :herb: :clapper:
Sam: I am team garden. Need more plants in my life. Also pie tasting. :pie:
Jordan: Cinema for me. I have a new sweater and I'm emotionally prepared for subtitles. :sweater:
Asha: Garden but only if someone helps me carry a giant pot. Also can volunteer at the kids' seed-planting table. :seedling:
Kai: Cinema, unless the band in the garden is actually a ukulele ensemble. Then maybe. :ukulele:
Riley: Quick vote: G for garden, C for cinema. Reply with letter. I’ll announce by 8pm.
Sam: G
Jordan: C
Asha: G
Kai: C
events-bot: Riley created event draft "Spring Fair (tentative)" — Sat 10:00. Reminder set.
Riley: Tally is 2-2 tie, but Sam and Asha are more likely to drag plants to my car, so garden it is. Plan: meet at the community lot by 10am, bring cash for pie, and sunscreen. If rain, fallback to cinema and I’ll DM the new time.
Jordan: I’ll still do cinema if you need a last-minute substitute. Otherwise I’ll come for pie after work. Send photos! :camera_with_flash:
Sam: I’ll bring folding cart and enthusiasm.
Asha: I'll bring labels and gloves. Also anyone up for a post-fair picnic?
Riley: Picnic sounds perfect — bring a blanket. See you Saturday 10am. If anyone wants to join the cinema fallback, ping here and we’ll sort tickets.
